title: Synthetic stock exception policy v2
content: This fictional policy exists only for the Microsoft Foundry one-day workshop.
Escalate a shortfall of 8 units or more to the regional stock desk.
Include the store code, available quantity, demand, shortfall, and next scheduled delivery.
Do not claim that escalation has occurred unless an inspected system record proves it.
Never release reserved units or make clinical, substitution, or dosing recommendations.
